fix: Clip each native mesh quad to the horizontal footprint of nearby actual voxel collision boxes. Compute the lowest covered skin height, then lift each connected component by its greatest required support correction. This covers slab and step edges missed by a center ray without treating empty mesh/AABB corners as solid skin.
measurement: All saved-frame metadata and gameplay assertions were checked. Penetration measures the shortest exit distance for actual drawn mesh vertices inside actual collision boxes, with a 0.02-block rejection threshold. This is not a swept face/edge collision proof. Contact topology and physical dynamics can produce different fragment counts between runs.
